title: Bounded comparison of saved job evidence

publication.note: This is the reviewed acceptance decision proposed for protected integration. Until that PR merges, main's canonical MJ-REF-039 entry remains NOT_RUN.

scope: Read-only comparison of current saved matches for 2-10 jobs against one persisted verified career profile/search context, with shared versus role-specific structured job requirements and provenance. No new AI rewriting, scoring algorithm accuracy or arbitrary job-text optimization requirement is inferred.

criteria.criterion: Define a bounded, testable capability and stable data/API contract.
criteria.evidence: The API, pure service, typed client and connected UI define a bounded 2-10 selected-job contract tied to the current persisted profile/search/match context. Existing automated contract, recovery and connected-browser tests now pass on the actual merged revision.

criteria.criterion: Preserve verified-fact provenance, local-first behavior, deterministic safety gates, and current submission policy.
criteria.evidence: Structured requirement provenance, explicit unknown evidence, current scope/filter membership, immutable saved scores, sanitized stale/error handling, and read-only/no-external-request browser assertions pass on the integrated revision. The UI does not recast job requirements as candidate qualifications.

criteria.criterion: Add automated tests and evidence; code presence is not PASS.
criteria.evidence: Fresh integrated-source typecheck/build, 30 Python/API/browser tests plus 28 subtests and 20 frontend tests executed successfully. Exact revision/tree, module identity, commands, logs and hashes are retained. Earlier failing-first repair evidence remains supplemental.

criteria.criterion: Update the reference feature matrix and completion report when work begins and when verified.
criteria.evidence: This recording batch updates only MJ-REF-039 in the canonical reference matrix, regenerates the requirement index and completion dashboard/card from the authorities, and appends a source-bound milestone/checkpoint. The decision is recorded now, not backdated to implementation or issue closure. Protected-main publication remains a separate gate.

criteria.criterion: Implement independently unless license compatibility and attribution are explicitly verified.
